comparison: Fresh cumulative comparison of the f9-derived storage control against frozen 72c candidate.
scope: 131072 SQL ReplicatedApply rows; batch size 64; three durable collections; final full fold included; no RF3/network/admission; one shared host

timed: Per-batch key/value generation, mutation construction, command assembly, apply, and completion/publication checks.
The final full-group checkpoint and fold.
untimed: Database/schema/bootstrap and benchmark fixture construction before b.ResetTimer.
Post-append and post-fold statistics and file-space sampling.
timer_boundary.detail: fillRows runs after b.ResetTimer; the final group.Checkpoint is bracketed by StartTimer/StopTimer.

ratio_definition: Ratios are main-derived-control ns/op divided by candidate ns/op; values above 1 favor the candidate. Ratio-of-medians and median-paired-ratio are reported separately.

control_provenance.storage_source_overlay: seven f9 main storage files; see candidate2-pair/manifest.json and main-overlay.json

candidate_provenance.benchmark_harness_delta: four untimed tail-charge report metrics compared with the control harness; workload and timed path unchanged

environment.sample_order: three alternating pairs per workload; pair order main-control/candidate, candidate/main, main-control/candidate
environment.timing: go test benchmark ns/op from frozen test binaries; wall seconds also recorded per process

host_context.scope: Post-run only; not time-aligned to individual samples.
host_context.limitation: This snapshot cannot establish host conditions during the benchmark samples and does not identify the cause of run-to-run timing spread.
